questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and make sure the road is clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black and alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign tells you that a lane is ending and traffic will merge. Be prepared to slow down and allow other vehicles to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must do. Vehicles in the left lane must turn left at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto the shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a white rectangular regulation sign. You must obey it. Where this sign is posted, you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that cyclists may cross the road in this area. Watch for bicycles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that deer may cross the road in this area. Watch for wildlife.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign means you are entering a one-way street going the wrong way. You risk a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed allowed on this road. You can drive up to 55 mph, but you must slow down if conditions are bad, such as rain, snow, or ice.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about hazards ahead. This sign tells you that a construction worker (flagger) is ahead. Follow their directions carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means the lane will leave the freeway as an exit ramp. If you stay in this lane, you must exit. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway instead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead makes a sharp turn. Slow down as you would when turning at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about hazards ahead. This sign tells you that the right lane will be closed ahead due to construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows the only direction traffic is allowed to flow on this street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or turns, and keep more distance between your vehicle and other cars.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. Slow down to safely navigate the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you of a steep downhill section ahead. Adjust your speed to avoid brake damage and accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is always a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop and check for pedestrians and other vehicles before proceeding through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that traffic is merging from the right. Be prepared to safely allow merging vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a bicycle crossing or path. Drive carefully in this area because cyclists regularly cross or travel beside the road here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in work zones where both drivers and workers are at risk. This sign tells you that traffic violations in work zones result in doubled fines.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs enforce traffic rules that drivers must obey. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a traffic signal is coming at the next intersection.
